justifications.temporal_understanding: The agent needed multiple clarifications to understand the user's preferred week and date, despite the user providing it in the first turn.
justifications.negotiation_effectiveness: The agent effectively offered alternative slots when the user's preferred time was unavailable and continued to search for closer options.
justifications.conversational_efficiency: The agent asked for clarification on the date multiple times, which led to unnecessary turns.
justifications.customer_experience: The repeated clarifications regarding the date made the conversation feel a bit drawn out and less smooth than it could have been.
